rules.title: RSO Annual Rent Increase Cap
rules.requirement: For rental units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, landlords may raise rent by at most the annual allowable percentage set by the city, currently 3%, plus certain fee surcharges.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.exemptions: Non-RSO properties are not covered by this cap.
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is registered as subject to the RSO (determined via zimas.lacity.org lookup)

rules.title: RSO and SCEP Fee Pass-Through Surcharges
rules.requirement: In addition to the annual rent increase, landlords may pass through to tenants a monthly RSO surcharge of $1.61 and a monthly SCEP surcharge of $2.83, each for 12 months per year, with proper written notice and after registering the units.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units subject to the RSO where landlord has registered the units and given written notice.
rules.quoted_span: Effective January 1, 2022, the SCEP fee is a total of $67.94 per unit which landlords may collect from tenants at a rate of $2.83 per month for 12 months each year with a proper written notice.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the landlord has registered the units and given proper written notice

rules.conflict_note: The RSO surcharge has a separate effective date of January 1, 2020 stated in the same document for the RSO fee component.
